QuestInfo.name: [Weekly Quest] The Spreading Rage
QuestInfo.2: You have completed your assignment for the week. Talk to #p2230000# at #m241000220# again next week to receive a new weekly quest.

0.0: Hi there, buddy! Heading home after a hard day of helping out #p2230000# and #p2230001#? You sure are swell!\r\nUmm, by the way... could you do me a teeny-tiny favor? I'll give you an Anti-Magic Stone if you do!\r\n

yes.0: Oh, thank you, thank you! You've done a real good job clearing out the southern regions, but there are still plenty of big, bad monsters to fight in the northern reaches of Kritias Forest.\r\n
yes.1: Maybe I'm asking too much from you but could you go to #b#m241000223##k and eliminate #b600 #o8630012##k monsters? It's a tall order, but I know you can do it.\r\n#r(Caution! This quest will reset at midnight on Sunday.)#k

no.0: Oh, I understand. You should rest. You've been working real hard, after all! If you change your mind, I'll be here... always...

1.0: Did you really defeat 600 #o8630012# monsters? You're stupendous! Here, I promised you this Anti-Magic Stone, didn't I? It's all yours, you big hero!

yes.0: There's absolutely nothing left for you to do today.

default.0: Do you need more time to defeat #o8630012# monsters? Then hurry to #b#m241000223##k and eliminate #b600 #o8630012# monsters#k, quick as you can!
